playlist.name: Team ActionSack

published_2005_catalog.scope:
Extract published Bungie factual catalog rows without inventing hidden weights.
Existing unmodified Wayback primary HTML owns the data. Comma-separated published
map rows stay grouped; source spelling and contradictory metadata are preserved.
limitations: Published ordinal weight order only; no numeric weights.
No complete TMS variant buffers or per-map overrides.
An older dated catalog is not the final 2010 catalog.
Metadata contradictions preserved; executable evidence controls source-era admission.

playlists.name: Rumble Pit
playlists.description: Put your skill and wits to the test against up to seven opponents.  Plays Slayer and a smattering of objective games.

playlists.name: Rumble Training
playlists.description: Practice games from the Rumble Pit and new variants in this unranked playlist.  Guests are allowed and any size party can join.
references_or_notes: Essentially this is Rumble Pit + the following gametypes:

playlists.name: Double Team
playlists.description: Enter solo or bring a partner for intense 2 vs. 2 team battles. Plays a mix of team slayer and objective gametypes.

playlists.name: Team Slayer
playlists.description: Join alone or as a party for a two team ranked game of Slayer with up to eight players.

playlists.name: Team Skirmish
playlists.description: Join alone or as a party for a ranked two team game of up to eight players. Plays primarily CTF and other objective games.

playlists.name: Team Training
playlists.description: Practice games from the team playlists plus some new variants in this unranked playlist.  Guests are allowed and any size party can join.
references_or_notes: Uses same playlist as Team Skirmish + Team Slayer + the following gametypes:

playlists.name: Team Snipers
playlists.description: Play ranked Team Slayer games using only your wits and a sniper rifle. Parties of up to four are allowed.

playlists.name: Team Hardcore
playlists.description: Two teams of four wage war in a variety of ranked gametypes featuring non-default starting weapons. Motion sensor is disabled.

playlists.name: Multi-Team
playlists.description: Engage in fierce unranked battles between 4 three-person teams. Guests are allowed and any size party can join.

playlists.name: 6v6 Team Battle
playlists.description: Join alone or as a party and play ranked two team game of up to 12 players.  Plays a mix of slayer and objective games.

playlists.name: Big Team Battle
playlists.description: Play ranked two team slayer and objective games up to 16 players.

playlists.name: Clanmatch
playlists.description: Join as a party of 4-5 Clan members to challenge another Clan for glory and honor!  Plays slayer and objective variants.
references_or_notes: Maps and gametypes are a combination of Team Slayer and Team Skirmish playlists.

playlists.name: Team ActionSack
playlists.description: Play a wide assortment of community inspired unranked two team gametypes. Guests are allowed and any size party can join.

playlists.name: Rumble Armory
playlists.description: Master the Halo 2 arsenal in unranked free-for-all matches featuring a wide variety of starting weapons.  Guests are allowed and any size party can join.

limits: Do not relabel 2005 published rows or 2007 published names as a verified final-2010 download.
Every published row lacks numeric weight and complete per-map variant configuration.
Source primary conflicting metadata is preserved rather than silently corrected.
Action Sack and clan queues are restored offerings in addition to the dated May2007 nine-playlist publication.
Complete native gameplay is required for every row in a claimed full historical pool.
